1.name: 첫걸음
1.guide: 3~5 words per sentence. Only the most common everyday words. Present tense. Polite set phrases a beginner can memorize whole.

2.name: 한 걸음 더
2.guide: 4~8 words per sentence. Common verbs (want, need, have, go, like), simple questions with what/where/when/how, can/could requests. Present and simple past.

3.name: 자신 있게
3.guide: 6~12 words per sentence. Natural spoken English with I'd like / Would you / I'm going to / I've been. Short two-person exchanges are fine.

steps.focus: ordering drinks and food, asking for the bill
restroom, taxi, asking someone to speak slowly
saying where it hurts, buying medicine
telling time, days of the week, today/tomorrow
name, where I live, my hobbies, my job
calling family abroad, can you hear me, call you back
praising, playing, bedtime, simple questions to a child
talking about trip plans with I'm going to
describing symptoms, how long, doctor's advice
small talk with neighbors and other parents
simple past stories, when I was young
compliments, thanking warmly, responding to thanks
lost item, wrong order, asking for help
describing my day from morning to night
